definition: The source status is the counterexample/obstruction status attached to the normal witness before motif compression.
source_condition: W is normal and has finite support plus canonical motif M
caveat: Classification only; not a theorem about arbitrary status semantics.

definition: The compressed status is the status evaluated on W_comp=normalize(rewrite(W,M,M_comp)).
compressed_condition: W_comp is normalized after motif rewrite
proof_requirement: normal-form and status evaluation must be defined
caveat: Normal-form preservation remains proof-sketch for arbitrary motif rewrites.

definition: Status preservation depends on accepted motif equivalence/refinement being a congruence for all status-relevant fields.
source_condition: M has accepted lower-rank compressed representative M_comp
compressed_condition: M_comp replaces M in the witness
caveat: This is the central open status hypothesis.

definition: Compressed motif payload should refine source motif payload.
compressed_condition: payload fields are rewritten to M_comp
caveat: Payload refinement is not status preservation.

source_condition: status certificate is invariant under replacing M by M_comp
proof_requirement: motif status congruence plus normal-form preservation

definition: Compression creates a smaller counterexample/status witness.
source_condition: compression is accepted and W_comp status is valid counterexample or reduced obstruction
compressed_condition: W_comp is smaller under support/canonical lexicographic measure
proof_requirement: measure decrease plus valid reduced-status theorem
caveat: Measure decrease is proved; status transfer/reduction remains open.

definition: Compression destroys status without proving reduced/refuted branch.
source_condition: status fields are not congruent across the motif rewrite
caveat: Failure is named, not hidden as success.

definition: After operation proof closure, unresolved support>8 residual can become deferred higher-support escape.
proof_requirement: higher-support bound after operation proofs close

definition: Accepted compression may strictly decrease support_size.
caveat: Measure decrease does not imply status preservation.

definition: If support size is fixed, accepted compression strictly decreases motif rank.
proof_requirement: rank comparison under canonical motif contract
caveat: Rank decrease is selected-contract arithmetic, not global completeness.

definition: Payload fields must refine along the motif rewrite.
source_condition: payload roles agree under accepted motif refinement
caveat: Layerwise payload proof remains sketch outside accepted contract.

definition: Recognized family-chain source form must remain recognized or route to a named blocker.
compressed_condition: W_comp remains recognized or named blocker

definition: Failure after operation proof closure can become deferred higher-support escape.
source_condition: all operation-specific proof routes close or fail
